AKISISTER-REDLEAFMARK.description:
Retain for 1 turn.
When you play or exhaust a Skill with [orange]"Red Leaf Mark"[/orange], gain 1 stack of [gold]Autumn Essence[/gold].
Can overwrite [orange]"Sweet Potato Mark"[/orange]; upon doing so, gain 2 stacks of [gold]Autumn Essence[/gold].
Removed when sent to the discard pile.
AKISISTER-REDLEAFMARK.title: "Red Leaf Mark"
AKISISTER-SWEETPOTATOMARK.description:
Retain for 1 turn.
When you play or exhaust a Skill with [orange]"Sweet Potato Mark"[/orange], gain 1 stack of [gold]Fragrance[/gold].
Can overwrite [orange]"Red Leaf Mark"[/orange]; upon doing so, gain 2 stacks of [gold]Fragrance[/gold].
Removed when sent to the discard pile.
AKISISTER-SWEETPOTATOMARK.title: "Sweet Potato Mark"
